sheets.prompt:
Premium game-ready painted VFX sprite sheet for a spectacular weapon master's awakening: a THREE-DIMENSIONAL CROWN OF TWELVE PLATINUM SPECTRAL SWORDS opening behind the hero, then accelerating into orbit and firing away. Same sharp white/cyan/cobalt/gold energy painting language as the attached sword-tempest reference. Highly elaborate, majestic, dangerous sword blades, metallic luminous facets and flowing blue energy, gold sparks. No character.

EIGHT unique sequential cels in an exact 4-column by 2-row grid, wide 2:1 canvas. Each cel is an equal square. PURE SOLID OPAQUE BLACK RGB(0,0,0) BACKGROUND for additive blending, not transparent. Absolutely no broad pale fog, no white/gray backdrop, no checkerboard, no text, labels, lines or grid. EVERY cel's COMPLETE shape must be fully contained within the central 65% of its square, with at least 17% empty BLACK border on all FOUR sides. Full tips of ALL swords and ALL trails visible. Do NOT crop the glow or blade tips. Dark black gaps between every cel.

Chronological frames:
1. Five small broken ivory blade fragments and a compact blue energy convergence, dark empty center.
2. Twelve elegant narrow white/cyan spectral swords assemble and point outward in a tilted elliptical crown seen in perspective, blade tips lengthening, empty central space where the character will stand.
3. Full radiant sword crown, twelve ornate edged swords alternating long and short, gold filaments connecting their motion, intricate blue flame energy individually wrapped around blades, imposing crisp silhouette.
4. Crown begins rotating: each sword bends into a fast beautiful tapered sword-trail, twelve sharp white/cyan edges plus golden fragments. Central opening remains empty.
5. Violent peak rotation, crown becomes an asymmetrical whirling tornado of layered BROAD blade ribbons, large sharp ivory tips, ragged cobalt negative space, intricate gold forks.
6. Four clusters of swords shoot diagonally outward, entire formation ruptures into a broad jagged cross of blade energy. All tips still visible inside cell.
7. Swords have flown away, short fractured slashing remnants and angular blue-gold splinters drift outward.
8. Last few tiny fading sparks, almost entirely black.

Sharp sword shapes, forceful layered material changes, no simple computer-generated circles, no neon wireframe rings, no decorative logo, no rigid still icon copied eight times. Gorgeous polished top-tier RPG ultimate effect, consistent pivot and truly different animated drawings.

Fix only the framing and clipped edges of this eight-frame VFX sprite sheet. Preserve its exact intense white/cyan/cobalt/gold painted vertical sword explosion artwork and sequence. Keep solid pure BLACK background, 4 columns x 2 rows layout, same aspect ratio.

Every effect must be COMPLETE with NO flat rectangular cutoffs: extend and redraw the currently cropped tops of the descending blade columns into FINITE POINTED TIPS or tapering blue trails, and extend the currently cropped left/right horizontal explosion wings into graceful FINITE SHARP TIPS. The top-row final two effects and bottom-row first effect have obvious flat cut-off edges; repair those. Do not simply keep rectangular edges.

Then fit each entire effect inside the CENTRAL 65% of its own square cell, leaving at least 17% purely BLACK empty margin on EVERY side. This means ALL eight cels must get substantially smaller on the sheet. Peak drawings may be larger than the first/last, but none extends outside this central region. The brightest contact point remains at 65% of cell height, same location across all frames. No particle or light reaches the cell edge. No grid, no lettering, no new backgrounds or white haze. Render a game-ready seamless sequence, same premium fantasy swordmaster ultimate style.
sheets.initialPrompt:
Paint a new EIGHT-frame FINAL AWAKENING IMPACT animation sprite sheet for the same weapon-master skill as the attached reference. Match its sharp expensive Korean action RPG VFX treatment: savage broad ivory-white sword-edge energy, electric cobalt and cyan, metallic gold sparks, densely layered hand-painted tapering cuts. This new sheet is a different attack phase: HEAVEN-SPLITTING VERTICAL SWORD JUDGMENT, a massive sword-shaped column crashes into the ground and ruptures outward.

Technical layout exactly 4 columns x 2 rows of EIGHT EQUAL SQUARE CELLS, wide 2:1 image. Pure opaque black RGB(0,0,0) background for additive rendering. NO transparency, gray/white background, paper texture, cloudy background or visible cell grid. Pure black border at least 12% around EVERY cell. Everything contained in its own cell, with no clipped particles. Frame center stays fixed. Ground contact is consistently at 70% cell height. No actual floor texture, no characters, no UI, no lettering, no logos.

Left to right, top row then bottom:
1. Narrow long tapering blade-shaped shaft descending from top center toward the contact point, compressed silver-white light and blue trailing threads.
2. The sword shaft hits the point: a sharp small brilliant gold-white starburst, jagged broad blue blades start breaking diagonally outward.
3. MONUMENTAL PEAK: huge intricate ivory/cyan vertical cleaving blade embedded in a fiercely exploding angular star of blade splinters and blue energy pressure waves, forceful and dazzling. White luminous core is tightly contained and still sword-shaped, not a featureless white blob.
4. The vertical sword column shatters lengthwise; two enormous wing-shaped fans of broad torn blade energy blast left and right from the contact point, with detailed gold lightning and dark blue negative spaces.
5. A wide low horizontal shockfront formed of jagged overlapping sword slashes erupts outward below the collapsing blue-white pillar; flying sharp gold-white shards above it.
6. The central blade breaks into falling blue luminous fragments, outward pressure fans disintegrate into intricate tapered arcs and sparks.
7. Only shorter groundward blue cutting wisps, a few falling bright shards and gold sparks remain.
8. Sparse tiny diminishing blue and gold embers; mostly black.

These are eight DIFFERENT coherent sequential paintings, not the same image resized. The peak should feel like an ultimate that tears the whole battlefield open. Strong directional mass, detailed flowing cut surfaces, violent splintering, clarity and depth. NOTHING resembling simple thin computer rings or a decorative emblem.
